name: cleantake
description: Recover damaged dialogue using simultaneous backup recordings. Free desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux. Audio stays local.
readme_summary: CleanTake is a free, open-source desktop application for Mac, Windows, and Linux that recovers damaged dialogue by aligning and comparing simultaneous backup recordings with a primary microphone. It allows users to select replacement audio segments, ensuring transparency by tracking the source of every repair.
key_features: Recovers damaged dialogue from simultaneous recordings
Aligns main microphone with backup recordings
Desktop app for Mac, Windows, and Linux
primary_use_case: Restoring corrupted or lost audio segments in dialogue recordings by leveraging backup microphone tracks.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled audio restorer, depicted as a meticulous artisan, carefully piecing together a shattered ceramic vase. The vase fragments represent damaged audio, and the artisan is using glowing threads of sound waves to seamlessly connect them with pieces from a perfectly intact backup vase. Small, subtle UI elements resembling audio waveforms and a 'source visible' toggle are integrated into the artisan's workbench. The background is a dimly lit, cozy studio with vintage audio equipment. The overall mood is one of precision and recovery. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with soft, focused lighting and a warm color palette, emphasizing the delicate repair process.

name: CalClock
description: Native Win32 application for customizable floating analog and digital clocks, calendars, alarms, time zones, offsets, NTP synchronization, and multi-monitor fullscreen display.
readme_summary: CalClock is a native Windows application that allows users to create and customize multiple floating analog and digital clocks, calendars, and combined panels on their desktop. It offers extensive configuration options for appearance, time zones, alarms, and synchronization, running unobtrusively from the system tray.
key_features: Multiple independently configurable floating widgets (clocks, calendars)
Support for various time zones and time offsets
Alarm functionality with local commands and script calls
Runs from the notification area with no permanent control window
primary_use_case: Desktop customization with highly configurable floating clocks and calendars on Windows.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, stylized desktop scene where numerous small, intricately designed analog and digital clocks, along with elegant calendar widgets, float gracefully above a stylized representation of the Windows desktop. Each widget has a unique personality, showcasing different fonts, colors, and time zones, as if they are individual characters. Subtle glowing lines connect them to a central, almost magical 'CalClock' icon in the system tray, symbolizing their centralized control and customization. The overall mood is organized yet playful, highlighting the freedom and personalization CalClock offers. The art style should be a clean, 3D isometric illustration with a soft, inviting color palette.

name: prune
description: A Windows uninstaller that finishes the job: runs the program's own uninstaller, then finds and quarantines what it left behind. Plus a disk map, cleaner, startup manager and SSD health. No telemetry.
readme_summary: Prune is a Windows uninstaller that goes beyond the standard removal process by also identifying and quarantining leftover files, registry keys, and scheduled tasks. It consolidates multiple system management tools into one application, offering features like disk visualization, cache cleaning, and SSD health monitoring without collecting user telemetry.
key_features: Advanced uninstallation by removing leftover files and registry keys
Quarantine system for recoverable removal of leftovers
primary_use_case: To provide a comprehensive and thorough uninstallation experience for Windows applications, while also offering additional system cleanup and health monitoring tools.
cover_image_prompt: A meticulous digital gardener carefully pruning overgrown digital plants, representing uninstalled applications. The gardener uses glowing digital shears to snip away stray digital vines and roots (leftover files and registry entries) that the initial 'uninstall' tool missed. A small, clean UI element in the corner shows a 'quarantine' bin where the pruned elements are temporarily placed. The background is a clean, organized digital landscape, subtly hinting at a Windows environment. The overall mood is one of order and thoroughness, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style with clear iconography and a bright, organized color scheme.

name: Lufus
description: A modern and easy to use drive imaging and formatting utility inspired from Rufus and written in python for Linux-based systems
readme_summary: Lufus is a Python-based utility for Linux systems designed for creating bootable USB drives and performing drive imaging and formatting. Inspired by Rufus, it aims to provide a user-friendly and comprehensive tool for managing bootable media and system images on Linux.
primary_use_case: Creating bootable USB drives and performing drive imaging/formatting on Linux systems.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic USB drive character holding a glowing blueprint, standing in a clean, modern workshop. The character is actively 'sculpting' a digital landscape of operating system icons (Linux, Windows) onto a blank hard drive. Subtle digital particles and lines of code flow from the blueprint to the hard drive, illustrating the creation process. In the background, a stylized Linux penguin observes approvingly. The overall mood is helpful and efficient, with a bright, clean color palette and a 3D isometric illustration style, emphasizing ease of use and technical capability.

name: Proxima
description: Multi-AI MCP Server - Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini & Perplexity to your coding tools without any API
readme_summary: Proxima is a multi-AI model connection server that integrates various large language models (like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity) into coding tools such as Cursor and VS Code. It enables users to leverage these AI models through free browser login sessions or local providers, featuring a self-healing Python agent, multi-agent delegation, and cross-session memory.
key_features: Connects multiple AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) to coding tools
Uses free browser login sessions or local offline providers
Supports editors like Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, and Claude Desktop
REST API, WebSocket, CLI, and SDKs for integration
primary_use_case: To provide a unified interface for developers to access and utilize multiple AI language models within their preferred coding environments without direct API key management.
cover_image_prompt: A conductor standing at a podium, orchestrating a symphony of diverse AI entities (represented as glowing, distinct orbs of light, each subtly hinting at ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity). The conductor's baton is a stylized code editor cursor, directing streams of data (represented as glowing lines) from the AI orbs into a central, illuminated coding interface displayed on a large screen behind them. The scene is a grand, futuristic concert hall, with subtle digital particles and UI elements floating in the air. The overall mood is one of harmonious integration and powerful AI collaboration. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style with a vibrant, tech-inspired color palette.

name: jmeter
description: Apache JMeter open-source load testing tool for analyzing and measuring the performance of a variety of services
readme_summary: Apache JMeter is an open-source Java application designed for performance and load testing of various services. It simulates heavy loads to analyze application strength and performance under different conditions.
key_features: Performance and load testing for web applications, SOAP/REST, FTP, JDBC, LDAP, JMS, Mail, and more
Fully featured Test IDE for recording, building, and debugging test plans
Command-line mode for non-GUI testing on any Java-compatible OS
Dynamic HTML reporting and live reporting to third-party databases
Easy correlation for extracting data from HTML, JSON, XML, and text formats
Highly extensible core with scriptable samplers (Groovy), pluggable tiers, and data visualization plugins
primary_use_case: Load and performance testing of web applications and other services.
cover_image_prompt: A powerful, stylized anvil labeled 'JMeter' is being struck by a relentless barrage of digital hammers, each hammer representing a simulated user. The anvil is placed on a sturdy platform representing a web server, which shows subtle signs of strain but remains stable. Sparks fly from the impact, transforming into glowing data points that form intricate performance graphs and charts in the air around the anvil. In the background, a digital dashboard displays real-time metrics like response times and error rates. The scene is set in a clean, modern workshop with dramatic lighting, emphasizing the robust testing process. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clear, bold lines and a vibrant, tech-focused color palette.
